subject: tests need to be more robust

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: tests need to be more robust
parts:
Is there any way to try to fix the tests so that they don't fail
for reasons unrelated to the pull requests? It's very frustrating
from a developer perspective and is one of the main reasons we can't
quickly merge pull requests.

Maybe we can push the model tests back to something more like a continuous
integration and something not related to each pull request?

The real danger, though, is that I just pretty much ignore failures
because of the overwhelming numbers of false positives. I only
start getting worried about them when there's a release imminent, like
now.

- Bob
